story.text: 인천공항 도착장은 사람들로 가득했다. 캐리어 바퀴 소리와 안내 방송 소리가 뒤섞여 시끄러웠고, 나는 지도 앱만 들여다보며 걸음을 서둘렀다.
story.reading: in-cheon-gong-hang do-chak-jang-eun sa-ram-deul-lo ga-deuk-haet-da. kae-ri-eo ba-kwi so-ri-wa an-nae bang-song so-ri-ga dwi-seok-yeo si-kkeu-reo-wot-go, na-neun ji-do aeb-man deul-yeo-da-bo-myeo geol-eum-eul seo-dul-leot-da.
story.en: Incheon Airport's arrival hall was packed with people. The clatter of suitcase wheels mixed with the PA announcements, and I hurried along with my eyes glued to a map app.

story.text: 방금 찾은 수하물을 어깨에 고쳐 메다가, 가방 옆주머니가 열려 있는 줄도 몰랐다.
story.reading: bang-geum chaj-eun su-ha-mul-eul eo-kkae-e go-chyeo me-da-ga, ga-bang yeop-ju-meo-ni-ga yeol-lyeo iss-neun jul-do mol-lat-da.
story.en: While adjusting the baggage I'd just picked up on my shoulder, I didn't even notice my bag's side pocket was open.

story.text: 열쇠고리 하나가 스르륵 미끄러지더니, 바닥에 소리 없이 떨어졌다.
story.reading: yeol-soe-go-ri ha-na-ga seu-reu-reuk mi-kkeu-reo-ji-deo-ni, ba-dak-e so-ri eop-si tteol-eo-jyeot-da.
story.en: A keychain slid out and dropped silently to the floor.

story.text: 마침 비행을 마치고 걸어오던 규현이 그 소리를 들었다. 그는 몸을 숙여 작은 열쇠고리를 집어 들었다. 은색 고리에 달린 별 모양 장식이 조명 아래 반짝였다.
story.reading: ma-chim bi-haeng-eul ma-chi-go geol-eo-o-deon gyu-hyeon-i geu so-ri-reul deul-eot-da. geu-neun mom-eul suk-yeo jak-eun yeol-soe-go-ri-reul jib-eo deul-eot-da. eun-saek go-ri-e dal-lin byeol mo-yang jang-sik-i jo-myeong a-rae ban-jjak-yeot-da.
story.en: Just then, Kyuhyun, who had finished his flight and was walking by, heard the sound. He bent down and picked up the small keychain. The little star charm on the silver ring glinted under the lights.

story.text: 고개를 들어 주인을 찾던 그의 눈이, 저만치 앞서 걷는 나의 뒷모습에 멈췄다. 첫눈에 반한다는 게 이런 걸까 — 그는 이상하게도 눈을 뗄 수가 없었다.
story.reading: go-gae-reul deul-eo ju-in-eul chat-deon geu-ui nun-i, jeo-man-chi ap-seo geot-neun na-ui dwit-mo-seub-e meom-chwot-da. cheon-nun-e ban-han-da-neun ge i-reon geol-kka — geu-neun i-sang-ha-ge-do nun-eul ttel su-ga eop-seot-da.
story.en: As he looked up to find the owner, his gaze stopped on my figure walking ahead in the distance. Was this what people meant by falling for someone at first sight? Strangely, he couldn't look away.

story.text: '…따라가서 돌려줘야겠네.' 그는 낮게 혼잣말을 하며 열쇠고리를 손안에 꼭 쥐었다.
story.reading: tta-ra-ga-seo dol-lyeo-jwo-ya-get-ne. geu-neun nat-ge hon-jal-mal-eul ha-myeo yeol-soe-go-ri-reul son-an-e kkok jwi-eot-da.
story.en: "...Guess I'd better go catch up and give this back." He murmured under his breath, closing his hand tightly around the keychain.

story.text: 몇 분 전까지만 해도 평범했던 하루가, 그 작은 열쇠고리 하나로 완전히 달라지려 하고 있었다.
story.reading: myeot bun jeon-kka-ji-man hae-do pyeong-beom-haet-deon ha-ru-ga, geu jak-eun yeol-soe-go-ri ha-na-ro wan-jeon-hi dal-la-ji-ryeo ha-go it-seot-da.
story.en: A day that had been perfectly ordinary just minutes earlier was about to change completely — all because of one small keychain.

words.example_en: There were many people in the airport's arrival hall.

words.example: 수하물을 찾은 후에 가방을 다시 멨다.
words.example_reading: su-ha-mul-eul chaj-eun hu-e ga-bang-eul da-si met-da
words.example_en: After finding my baggage, I put my bag back on.
The keychain attached to the bag was pretty.
He said he fell for her at first sight.
The wallet fell to the floor.

sentences.en: The airport's arrival hall was full of people.
A keychain fell out of the bag.
He recognized me at first sight.
After finding my baggage, I hurried along.
He quietly picked up the keychain.
